issues.description: The problem statement (UML and explicit note) requires the Animal constructor and the name getter/setter to use protected visibility, but the solution implementation declares a public constructor and public getName()/setName(). This discrepancy between the specification and the reference implementation may confuse students about the intended visibility and inheritance encapsulation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the reference implementation match the specification: change the Animal constructor and the name getter/setter to protected (e.g., protected Animal(String name); protected String getName(); protected void setName(String)). Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to permit public visibility for the constructor and accessors and remove the explicit note requiring protected visibility. Choose one consistent approach and apply it across the problem statement, template, and solution.
